steps: A combined lamp and battery load the head.

steps: Identify the area that needs cooling.
Direct a small fan toward the face.

Select or exchange the required plug.

Unfold the bag into a laptop and mouse surface.

Protect it with a release liner.

steps: Locate corners vulnerable to impact.
Place an elastic bumper around them.
Deformation of the buffer softens impact.

name: Equipotentiality

steps: Identify the difference in working heights.
Adjust the platform to match the loading bed.
Transfer the cargo horizontally once aligned.

name: The other way round

steps: The runner stays in the same location.
Rollers move the belt backward.
Walking or running needs less travel space.

name: Spheroidality

steps: Press the handle to produce rotation.
The round mop head and basket rotate.
Water moves outward through the basket.

name: Dynamics

steps: Use an upright configuration at low speed.
Adjust joints and body to the conditions.
A lower, longer shape can reduce aerodynamic drag.

name: Partial or excessive action

steps: Fill the measure slightly above the rim.

name: Another dimension

steps: Secure bicycles to a rotating rack.

Rotate the required bicycle to an accessible position.

steps: Grip the branch with a clamp.
Apply repeated vibration to the branch.

name: Continuity of useful action
